requester1: no management controls
agent: no management controls
a create that loses the Platform is reported as unknown, reconciled by reading, then retried once with the same id
a write during an outage is never reported as plain success or failure
server-side search and pagination over real data
state filter scans authorized records and agrees with the API
dashboard counts equal what the API authorizes, and the scope is stated
unauthenticated BFF API and Platform ingress calls are rejected
browser cookie holds no token and the session JSON carries no token
writes without CSRF token or with a foreign Origin are rejected
the BFF forwards only the it-helpdesk allowlist
a requester cannot read, list, drive or audit another requester's ticket
role grants: requester cannot run agent transitions, agent cannot create or edit, admin cannot create
closing belongs to the requester: agent and other requesters cannot confirm a resolved ticket
locked states refuse edits and deletes; invalid transitions are 409 and change nothing
the state cannot be set through generic writes
audit is only for administrators and redacts the description
category management is administrator-only on the backend
a stale version is a 409 conflict and does not overwrite
create with a client UUID is idempotent; reusing the id for another payload conflicts and another user learns nothing
two staff members racing the same transition: exactly one winner
validation errors are keyed by field
an ended session shows the sign-in dialog and signing in again returns to the app
logout ends the BFF and identity provider sessions
